disputedClaims.finding: ESA identifies DR3 as the latest full public release and schedules DR4 for 2026-12-02. No 2025 DR4 exists.
disputedClaims.consequence: Do not create a DR4 placeholder or relabel DR3. Use a frozen DR3 query as a separately identified comparator.

disputedClaims.finding: The canonical PREM is Dziewonski and Anderson (1981). EarthScope distributes that model; no authoritative 2025 PREM release was found.
disputedClaims.consequence: Cite the 1981 model and freeze the distributor file. A newer Earth model must use its own actual name and provenance.

disputedClaims.finding: No named authoritative catalogue matching this exact count and scope was authenticated. Euclid/Galaxy Zoo provides a much larger morphology/winding catalogue but not the claimed numerical pitch dataset.
disputedClaims.consequence: EARTH-GAL-001 remains data-blocked for numerical pitch residuals. Do not use morphology classes as silent pitch-angle measurements.

disputedClaims.finding: NASA Exoplanet Archive reports thousands of confirmed planets, not confirmed biosignatures. No authoritative catalogue of thousands of confirmed biosignature planets exists.
disputedClaims.consequence: EARTH-GAL-006 cannot be validated against the claimed population. Confirmed planets, habitability proxies, and biosignature evidence must remain separate fields.
